description: This file defines a struct 'SpanBufferWriter' implementing 'IBufferWriter<byte>' for handling buffer writing operations using spans, including methods for advancing the buffer and retrieving memory or span, with exception handling for capacity issues.

classes.name: SpanBufferWriter
classes.description: A struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> for writing to a span buffer with capacity checks and exception handling.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the number of bytes written by the specified count.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> for writing, throws exception if operation exceeds buffer capacity.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> for writing, throws exception if operation exceeds buffer capacity.

methods.name: GetException
methods.description: Generates and returns an exception based on whether the requested size exceeds the buffer's maximum length.
